## Multi-session rules (tower kit, level <LEVEL>)

**Recovery is by file, never by conversation.** Anything that exists only in this chat is lost when the session ends.

**One canonical file per fact type; everywhere else holds a pointer.**

| Fact | Canonical file |
|---|---|
| Rules and pointers | `CLAUDE.md` (budget <BUDGET> chars; a new rule retires one or becomes a script/hook check) |
| Current state, next step | `<MEMORY>` (≤ 40 lines, one line per workstream, edit the line, never append sections) |
| Who is working on what now | `<SESSIONS>` (hook-maintained; fill topic / branch / claims only) |
| Session-sized tasks | `<TASKS>` |
| Decisions, incl. rejected options | `<DECISIONS>` (`date · what · from X to Y · why · who depends on it`) |
| One-off gotchas and technical findings | `<GOTCHAS>` (newest first, one per entry) |

When a conclusion is overturned, mark the old one invalid in place and point to the new one; grep for other references.

**One session = one row of `<TASKS>`.** A row = one-sentence deliverable + done criteria + landing file + estimate + `config: <model> · thinking <off|high|xhigh>`. Missing a field: fill it before starting. Things that come up mid-session: ≤ 5 min answer directly, otherwise add a queue row and leave it. Two rows may share a session only when the second row's input is the first row's output.

**Start:** move the row to "<DOING>", fill the three SESSIONS cells. If another live row touches the same topic or file, stop and ask. Heavy work (> <CARD> min wall-clock, bulk judging, or bulk reading into context) gets a start card first: task / why / wall-clock and cost / model / how to stop.

**Close:** `/task-close` checks every done criterion against evidence (path, commit, run dir). No evidence = not done; criteria are never relaxed at close-out.

**Shared files** (<SHARED>): re-read from disk before editing, anchor-append only, never rewrite wholesale, never write via shell heredoc; after writing, grep that your paragraph survived.

**Claude-as-judge work leaves the working session:** pack it with `/judge-bundle`, judge it in a clean session or subagent with `/judge-bundle-run`, read back only the merged numbers. Every before/after comparison carries a third cell: one arm re-run with the same config (the noise floor).

**Paid API calls:** save per-item results and token usage to disk before printing summaries.
<L3>
